correctness.rationale: Exact unique-predecessor lemma identifies every detectable halfedge for probes of each vertex type. The monitoring criterion is proved for all n>=3, inclusion-exclusion supplies all probes, a full minimality argument yields star forests plus the all-but-one-original exceptions, and the labeled exponential formula and minimum multiplicities are deduced. A distinct BFS edge-deletion verifier checked 2,131,008 subsets over n=3..6 against each identity. No finite experiment is substituted for infinite proof.

value.rationale: Counting all edge-failure monitoring sets by two sensor classes and classifying all irredundant solutions answers a natural deployment question not determined by scalar optimization. The complete multivariate distribution, exact minimal-set cardinality spectrum and parity-dependent optimal configurations are motivated sensor-design invariants for an infinite vertex-transitive subdivision family. The work goes beyond a one-off numeric optimization or arbitrary finite slice.
